subject: For my Pyaaru 💌
body:
Hemluu Love,

Doing one of my favourite things right now, writing to my Pyaaru 🩷

My baby’s been fighting pain alone all day, and I wish I could’ve been
there to hold you, to make it all fade away.

These 603 kilometers…I feel them like a weight on my chest every single
day. It’s like my body remembers you even when my arms are empty.

Nights feel longer now, I keep turning to hug you only to find air 😞 when
I hold you again, I’m not letting you go, not for a second.

I miss your huggie attacks. 😫

I miss us cooking together with music in the background, stealing kisses
between songs.

I miss our quiet mornings, our coffee, Shiroo kisses, our morning cuddles
🥰 and ofc veggie shopping. Raat ko routa phirna and late night walks.

And most of all, I miss you, the warmth of you resting on me, your hair
brushing my face, the way I’d trace your skin like it was a map leading me
home.

I love being your bacchaa.

I love being your cutu.

I love being your man.

I love being your boyfriend.

I love being your husband.

Every heartbeat, every thought, every piece of me belongs to you, love. 💕💕

I really miss us.

Come back soon. My heart’s getting reckless without you.

Yours, always

Your Bubu 😘

subject: Your Bubu misses you 🥹
body:
My love,

It's been too long since I've written you an email. Here I am today, and I
find myself constantly refreshing my inbox, waiting for yours. They bring
such joy to my heart.

Today has been exhausting for both of us, one of the toughest days this
year for me. But even in the chaos, my thoughts keep drifting back to you.
I can't stop thinking about you, can't imagine being away from you for even
a moment. Work was particularly brutal today, but you know what kept me
going? You.

And then I realized, it's officially been 4 months since US. Four whole
months, pyaru! 🥹
It's the 26th today, and I still can't believe how far we've come.

From strangers to soulmates. From not knowing each other to you becoming my
entire world.

Let me share what's been on my heart, my love.

I knew your walls were tall. But I didn't try to climb them or knock them
down. I didn't jump over them or shout for you to come out.

Instead, I simply sat at the foot of the tallest wall and spoke softly to
you about everything and nothing, about dreams and silly thoughts, about
life and laughter, everything except those walls between us.

We laughed until our stomachs hurt. We talked about everything under the
sun, from selling coffee at roadside stalls to building our forever
together. We shared the stories of those who hurt us, how they did it,
when, and why.

We opened our hearts about our deepest insecurities, our wildest dreams,
and our quiet fears.

And then one day, you peeked over that wall with the most radiant smile.
There I was, still waiting, and suddenly we were face to face.

You hugged me, I kissed you, and those walls just... crumbled

That's when I knew I was completely, hopelessly in love with you. We were
in love.

You know what amazes me most? How you've turned my ordinary days into
something magical. Even when I'm stuck in traffic, I find myself smiling
because I know I'm coming home to you. You've made me believe in forever in
a way I never thought possible.

You are mine and I am yours. Always and completely 💕💕💕

I am on my way to pick you, my love. Aashu is counting the minutes until
you're back in my arms.

I love you more than I love crispy vadas soaked in hot sambar 🙈

Forever yours,
Bubu 💖

subject: To my Fiancé who gave me the best day of my life.
body:
Aashu, My dearest love.


Oh my husband ❤️ just writing that gives me chills every single time.

Consider this the very first email after our engagement, and what a day it
has been! From waking up to the chaos of interviews and running around with
a thousand things on my mind, to the moment my eyes searched the hall just
to get one glimpse of you  everything felt worth it. And when I finally saw
you, looking absolutely stunning, all my worries just melted away. The way
you took care of me, even when we were on stage, left me in tears. My love,
I don’t know what I did to deserve someone like you.


I cannot, truly cannot wait to spend the rest of my life with you. Every
moment spent by your side feels like magic, and today just confirmed it all
over again. That dance surprise ohhhh my God, I cannot even explain how
special it made me feel. I loved it with all my heart. I kept asking
myself, what good did I do in this life to be loved by someone as
thoughtful, kind, and selfless as you.


As if the dance was not enough, you had an entire proposal planned out in
front of our friends and cousins. You made me feel like the luckiest girl
alive. The pink gifts, the kinder joy bouquet, the cake that looked so
perfect and aesthetic every single detail was filled with love. I could
never have imagined someone putting in so much effort just to make me feel
this happy. I was overwhelmed in the best way possible, and in those
moments I silently promised myself to treasure you forever.


You have this way of making my problems yours, of holding me tight when
things get tough, and of reminding me that I am never alone. Today, when I
felt shaky towards the end, that one hug from you fixed everything. I
didn’t need anything else in the world but you.

And so my love, I want to make promises to you, not just for today, but for
every day of our lives. I promise to take care of you the way you take care
of me, to protect your heart like it is the most precious thing in the
world. I promise to stand by you in your happiest victories and your
hardest struggles. I promise to choose you every single day, no matter what
life throws at us. I promise to love you with the kind of love that grows
deeper, stronger, and more unshakable with time.

You are my best decision, my biggest blessing, and my forever. Thank you
for being my partner, my safe space, and my home.

Here’s to us, to a lifetime of surprises, laughter, love, and everything in
between. I cannot wait to start this beautiful journey as your wife.


With all my love, always and forever,

Lubbbbuuuu

Your Wifey ❤️

subject: I want us.
body:
Hemluu Love,

My Baby,
I just want you.
I want us, just us, because no one else feels right.
When I'm with you, everything makes sense. You bring me happiness and peace
that I can't find anywhere else.
The world can be confusing, but you are my clear place. I love how we
understand each other in ways no one else does.
Every moment together is special, and I want to keep making memories with
you.
You are my favorite person, and I can't imagine life without you.
:see_no_evil:

Isn't it strange? Once, we were just strangers passing through the same
world, living separate stories, never knowing that one day, your name would
feel like home to me:anatomical_heart: And now, before I eat, I hope you've
eaten. Before I sleep, I pray you're resting. Before I wish for anything, I
wish for you.

For your laughter, your peace, for the weight you carry to feel lighter.
How did you become the first thought in my mornings and the silent prayer
in my nights? :face_holding_back_tears:

I could spend a lifetime thanking the universe (that hanuman temple) for
the day our paths finally crossed.

With you, I don't have to pretend. I feel like most people around us are
fake, wearing masks, playing games.
But with you, I can be completely unfiltered. You make me feel safe to be
exactly who I am. No walls, no pretending, just me. Just us. I promise to
love you more each day. Not just say it, but show it in the small moments
and big gestures.

We'll take care of each other's hearts. Your wellbeing will always matter
to me. When you're tired, I'll be your rest. When you're worried, I'll be
your peace.

We'll do all the things we love. We'll laugh at inside jokes no one else
gets. We'll dance in the kitchen while cooking.
I'll tickle you until you can't breathe, you'll block the bathroom door
when I really need to pee. We'll sneak ice cubes down each other's shirts.
We'll randomly ask for rents of flats at 11 PM.

We'll annoy each other in the most loving ways possible, because that's
what makes us, us.
These silly, stupid, beautiful moments that no one else would understand.

We'll build a life where being together feels like coming home every single
day.

I can never get bored of you. Of us. Never.

Your heart.
Your safe place.
Your Husband,
Bobo 😘

subject: My heart at 1 am ❤️
body:
Hemluu Darling,

My sunshine.

It’s almost 1 and I can’t sleep. My mind is full of you, of us 🥹 I’m feel
excited, grateful, nervous, and all the butterflies.

I know things feel overwhelming right now. Work pulls us in different
directions, both our families have their expectations and worries, the
preparations seem endless, and sometimes the fear creeps in,  what if
something goes wrong? What if we’re moving too fast? I feel it all too.

But here’s what I know with absolute certainty, my love: Yes, you’ve made
the right choice. We have made the right choice.

I believe in us - not just today, not just next year, but in fifty years
when our hair is gray. I believe that your beautiful face will still be the
first thing I want to see every morning, and that wherever life takes us,
being together will always feel like coming home.

In every possible version of my life, in every dream I have about the
future, it’s you and me. Always you and me. 💕


Cutu we have something precious, we have trust, understanding, and the
maturity to handle whatever comes our way.
We are stronger together. So much stronger.


But I need to tell you something that’s been on my heart. As much as I love
being with you, and I truly can’t imagine spending a day without you -
sometimes I worry that I’m being too much. That maybe I’m forcing my
presence on you, taking away your personal space when you need it. Please,
my love, if it ever feels that way, tell me. Always tell me. I need you to
be completely honest about this.


These last few days have been so exhausting for both of us, physically and
mentally. Work has drained us, families have stressed us, and we’re both
running on empty. That’s exactly why when you’re back, I didn’t want to
waste a single precious minute. I want to be with you, to hold you, to just
breathe the same air as you. I need it real bad Payal. Your presence heals
me. 😩

You are my heart, my peace, my excitement for tomorrow. When the world
feels chaotic, you are my calm. When I’m scared about the future, your love
makes me brave.

Just come back and sleep on my chest already 🥹🥹

Your love.
Today. Tomorrow. Forever.
Aashu 💌

subject: The day we’ve dreamed of is almost here!
body:
Hemluuu

My dear boyfriend Aashu
(My soon to be husband) Get used to this cause I ain’t gonna stop calling
you with that name.

Right now, you’re on your way to Hubli with your parents and Pari and here
I am, already here, counting the hours until tomorrow, the day our lives
take that beautiful step we’ve both been dreaming of.

I’m so excited I can barely sit still. Every moment feels like the night
before something magical, and my heart just keeps whispering, “This is
ittttt! This is real.” Yet, tucked between all this joy is a flutter of
nervousness not because I have doubts, but because this is our big step.

The step we’ve imagined in quiet conversations, the one we’ve planned in
our hearts long before today.

I keep picturing the moment I see you. Those eyes I’ve missed, the way they
lock onto mine even in a crowded room, making the noise fade and the world
slow down. My heart will want to run straight into your arms, to hold you
like I never want to let go… but I’ll stop myself, just for that first
moment. Instead, I’ll take your hand in mine, feel its warmth, and let that
touch speak all the words I can’t find.

I know tomorrow will be full of smiles, laughter(hoping I don’t laugh like
a maniac) and the happy chaos of families meeting, but somewhere in all
that, there will be little moments that belong only to us, a glance across
the room, a secret smile, a squeeze of the hand that says, “We finally made
it”.

You’ve been my partner through everything the calm and the storms, the
laughter and the tears. You’ve held me when life felt heavy, celebrated
with me when it felt light, and loved me in ways I didn’t know I deserved.
And tomorrow, Aashu, when we make it official, it won’t just be a promise
for the future —it will be a celebration of everything we’ve already built
together.

Tomorrow, our “someday” becomes “now.” And I can’t wait to step into
forever with you, one heartbeat at a time!

Can’t wait to see you!
Counting hours.

Until then, miss me honey.

Yours. Today and forever
Payalo

subject: Before I Make You Mine Forever 🌻
body:
My Love,

My heart, my home, my entire universe,

Five days. In five days, I'll be standing in Hubbali, heart racing, palms
sweating, ready to meet the people who created the woman I love more than
life itself. 💕 Five days until I ask them for your hand, until I can
officially call you mine forever, until we begin writing the most beautiful
chapter of our story together.

But now, as I sit here thinking about our future, about the promises we'll
make to each other, about the life we're going to build, I needed you to
know something. I needed you to feel, in the deepest part of your soul,
exactly what you mean to me and what I'm going to spend every day of my
life doing for you.

My princess, for the rest of my life, I'm going to make you feel like the
most cherished woman who has ever existed. Every morning, I'll wake up and
my first thought will be you. Not just loving you, but making sure you feel
that love in every small gesture, every gentle touch, every time I look at
you like you're the miracle you are. I'll make you feel beautiful when
you're in your panda shorts with messy hair. I'll make you feel safe when
the world feels chaotic. I'll make you feel heard when you need to vent
about your day. I'll make you feel like the most precious thing in my
world, because you are.

We're going to love each other more every single day, baby. Not just the
easy kind of love, but the kind that chooses each other every morning. The
kind that says "I see your flaws and I love you more because of them." The
kind that keeps our promises sacred - to be honest even when it's hard, to
be gentle even when we're frustrated, to choose us even when life gets
overwhelming. We'll abide by our values of respect, trust, and
communication, and we'll build something so strong that nothing can shake
it.

Every experience, every adventure, every crisis at 3 AM - we're doing it
all together. When life throws chaos at us, we'll face it side by side,
hand in hand, hearts aligned. When problems come (and they will), we won't
face them alone - we'll face them as a team. When happiness arrives in
small moments or big celebrations, we'll share every second of joy. I want
all of it with you - the messy, the beautiful, the ordinary, the
extraordinary. All of it.

Before we say "I do," before I can call you my wife and you can call me
your husband, we're going to make promises to each other that will become
the foundation of our forever:

I promise to choose you every single day, even on the days when choosing
feels hard.

I promise to be your safe space - the arms you run to, the heart that
understands you, the person who never makes you feel like your emotions are
too much.

I promise to love your dreams as fiercely as my own, and to build a life
where both of us can flourish.

I promise to be patient with your healing, gentle with your heart, and
unwavering in my support of who you're becoming.

I promise that our home will always be filled with laughter, music, good
food, and the kind of love that makes people believe in fairy tales.

I promise to hold your hand through every season - the ones that test us
and the ones that bless us.

I promise to never let pride or ego come between us, to always choose
understanding over being right.

I promise to love your family as my own, to respect your friendships, and
to build a life that honors both of our worlds.

And I promise that fifty years from now, I'll still surprise you at bus
stops just to see that beautiful smile light up your face.

My darling, I want you to know that loving you has changed me in ways I'm
still discovering. You've taught me that love isn't just a feeling - it's a
verb, a choice, a daily commitment to seeing someone fully and choosing
them anyway. You've shown me what it means to be truly intimate, not just
physically but emotionally, spiritually, completely.

When I think about calling you my wife, when I imagine introducing you as
"my wife" to everyone we meet, my chest fills with such pride and gratitude
that I can barely contain it. You're going to be my wife. My partner. My
person. My home.

I know these five days are going to feel like forever, but soon, very soon,
we'll be on the other side of this moment, planning our wedding, choosing
our forever home, building the life we've been dreaming about in whispers
under blankets and during our sunset terrace talks.

subject: My answer to your question
body:
My love,

If you told me tomorrow that you don’t want us to be together anymore,
here’s what I would do:

First, I would listen. Really listen. Not to argue, not to convince you
otherwise, but to understand the pain behind those words. Because I know my
Payal, and those words wouldn’t come from a place of not loving me, but
from a place of being so hurt by the world that you’re trying to protect
both of us from more pain.


I would tell you that I see you. I see how your family is breaking your
heart, how they’re taking the most beautiful, giving soul I know and making
you question your worth. I see how you’re drowning in their toxicity, and
how the people who should be your safe harbor have become your storm.


Then I would gently remind you of something:
You’re not asking me this question because you want to leave. You’re asking
because you’re scared that the darkness you’re feeling will somehow poison
what we have.


But here’s what you need to know, baby, I’m not going anywhere. Not because
I’m stubborn, not because I don’t respect your choices, but because I see
beyond the hurt. I see the girl who gives her whole heart even when others
don’t deserve it. I see the strength it takes to keep loving when the world
has been cruel.

I see YOU, not just your pain.


I would fight for us, not by pressuring you, but by showing you every day
that there are humans who don’t take love for granted. That there are
people who see your worth even when you can’t see it yourself. That love
doesn’t have to hurt.
You’re starting to hate humans because the humans closest to you have
forgotten how precious you are. But love, don’t let their blindness make
you blind to the good that exists. Don’t let their failure to love you
properly make you believe that’s all love can be.


You are not too much. You are not a burden. You are not unworthy of gentle,
consistent love. Your family’s inability to see your light doesn’t dim it,
it just means they’re standing in the wrong place.


So if tomorrow you tell me you want to walk away, I’ll understand it’s not
really about us. It’s about a beautiful soul who’s been hurt so deeply that
running feels like the only way to breathe again.

 And I’ll love you through that too, because that’s what real love does, it
doesn’t abandon ship when the storm hits. It anchors deeper.


You’re not alone in this darkness, my love. You have me, and I have you,
and together we’re stronger than whatever they’re putting you through.


I’m here. Always here.

Your Aashu ❤️

subject: Love letter for my home ❤️
body:
My Dearest Payal,
You know I write emails to you every day, but this letter… this one was the
most difficult one for me. It took me 4 hours, my entire journey from
Chennai to Bangalore. I had to make it special because what I’m about to
tell you deserves nothing less than perfect.
When it comes to us, it’ll always be about loyalty and commitment. I’m not
walking away over arguments or disagreements. I won’t leave because of past
hurts or wounds that haven’t healed yet. Whatever challenges you face
become mine too. I embrace every part of who you are, including the
vulnerable pieces. We’re here to lift each other up, to learn and grow side
by side, not to tear each other down.
I need you to always feel comfortable telling me when I’m not showing up
the way you need me to. If something I’ve said or done has hurt you, please
tell me. Not so I can make excuses, but so I can become better - better for
you, better for us. Your feelings will always matter to me, above anything
or anyone. I expect the same from you. That’s how we build something strong
together, something that feels safe and secure for both our hearts.
Picture this: late night gym sessions together, coming home to cook dinner
side by side, sharing those intimate moments that make my heart race, then
washing the day away together before falling asleep in each other’s arms.
This is the kind of beautiful, ordinary life I want to build with you.
I feel this overwhelming need to protect and cherish you - to hold you
close until sleep finds you, to steal gentle kisses when you’re dreaming,
to make sure you never doubt how loved you are. I want to be your biggest
cheerleader, to create comfort wherever you are, and to help turn all your
dreams into reality.
What I’m most proud of about us is how we connected on the deepest level
first. We fell for each other’s hearts and minds before anything else
mattered. We didn’t need physical touch to recognize our souls calling to
each other. Something inside us just… knew.
Payal, I can’t imagine a life without you now. When I close my eyes and
think about our future, I see us everywhere - I see little feet running
around our house, tiny versions of us with your beautiful eyes and maybe my
stubborn streak (sorry in advance!). I picture us teaching them to ride
bikes, helping with homework, and watching them discover the world with the
same wonder you bring to everything.
I dream of us growing old together, maybe settling down in some quiet
countryside in Europe where we can watch the northern lights paint the sky
every night. Just you and me, wrapped in blankets, still finding new things
to talk about after decades together. Our parents visiting, playing with
our grandchildren, everyone gathered around one big table sharing stories
and laughter.
You know, people say three words can’t describe what we feel, and they’re
right. We’ve told each other things that mean so much more - “you’re my
home,” “my safe space,” “my peace.” You are my universe, Payal.
I know it’s only been three weeks since we’ve known each other, and maybe
that sounds crazy, but it already feels like you’re the one. Three weeks,
and yet it feels like my heart has been searching for you my entire life.
You’ve become the melody that plays in my head when everything else is
chaos. You’re the calm in every storm, the light that guides me through the
darkness.
In just these few weeks, you’ve shown me colors I never knew existed, made
music sound sweeter, and turned ordinary moments into adventures worth
treasuring.
And the things you’ve already done for me… those words of affirmation when
I needed them most, those motivation shots for work that kept me going, the
small gestures like those petals in my phone cover, getting chocolates just
because, choosing thoughtful gifts for my parents, coming to ISKCON without
hesitation the moment I asked you, and that hug… 😭 that perfect hug that
felt like coming home.
But what touches my heart most deeply is how you decided to quit smoking,
knowing how much it matters to me. You told me you’ll commit to a healthy
lifestyle - for you, for us. No words can describe how much that means to
me, how much YOU mean to me.
I know I’ve told you this, but I’ll tell you again - I’ll fight the world,
anyone and everyone for you, my sweetheart. I’ll protect you, cheer for
you, guide you. I’ll make sure you and us both cherish and are grateful for
each other every single day.
I promise to always keep my ego aside when it comes to us. I’ll always
prioritize you above anything or anyone. And I hope I can ask for the same
from you. After all, if we have decided to be with each other, and you are
going to be the one with me at my deathbed, why would anyone, why would the
world even matter to me? Because for what it’s worth, you are my world now.
I was in tears while writing this, thinking about all the beautiful moments
ahead of us. I want to sing all those romantic songs for you, with you. I
want to do all the crazy, fun, serene things together - visit every temple
that calls to our hearts, conquer every hiking trail, try cuisines from
every corner of the world, and travel to every continent hand in hand.
I know this might make you cry (happy tears, I hope!), but I needed you to
know that everything I dream of, everything I want to become, revolves
around the beautiful life we’re building together.
You are my princess, today and forever.
I love you, Payal.🌻❤️


- Aashu

body:
Hemluuu Chikii ❤️

Long, tough day for my princess, huh?

I just want you to know, I’m so proud of you.


You’re handling so much: family, doctor visits, cooking, and still
navigating those tough conversations. You’re not just strong, you’re a
warrior. Truly. You inspire me every single day.


Work was amazing today, cutie. That issue and two other long-pending ones?
Gone. Off the list. And you know what? I owe a part of that to you. Your
little shots of motivation yesterday worked magic. One of my most
productive days yet—thanks to you.


Now let me do my bit—with this email, to put a smile on that beautiful face.

You are my peace.

You’ve been through storms and still stand tall. I mean it when I say—I
haven’t even faced half of what you have, and yet, you’re the pillar. The
rock. The heart. And it humbles me.


And your smile? Don’t even get me started. It’s the cutest, most treasured
thing I’ve seen in my life. I’ll fight the world for it, pluck something
from the moon if that’s what it takes. Just to see it.


But, today, I want one thing from you—a forever promise:

Never say “I’m fine” when you’re not.

Please. It’s a gentle request from someone who genuinely wants to be there
for you 🥹

Never feel like sharing your pain is a burden. Not with me.

We’re not here just for the good times. Relationships shine brightest when
things get hard, and both partners show up. Always. You are never a problem
to fix. You’re someone I choose to stand beside.

I’m your guardian. You’re my princess. 🌻

And together, we’re responsible for each other’s peace.

We’ll protect it, through every storm, through every season.

So please, chiki, don’t take away my right to help you. And I promise—I’ll
never take yours away either.

Call me soon. I’m waiting to hear that voice.

With all my love, always

Your Guardian Knight,

Aashu 💛

Hemluuuu Chikki 🌻,

My Girlfriend (what a feeling, seriously 🤍)

I love how these emails have become our little safe space — a secret
channel where we pour our hearts out. Stuff that’s sometimes hard to say on
text or call just flows here. It gives me a chance to sit, breathe, and
really *feel*. I don’t want this to ever stop. It’s honestly the most
beautiful part of my day.

*You are my favourite notification.*

I was half-asleep with a slight headache when your email popped up.

vs. Magnus moment — me, just standing there in disbelief, awe, and happy

ourselves. I genuinely can’t imagine losing you now. I want to feel the way
I’ve felt these past 3 weeks for the rest of my life. And I want *you* to
feel how you felt after our first few dates — every single day. If not
more. More secure. More loved. More at peace.

Let *peace* be the biggest pillar in our story.

“So here I am promising you that I’ll hold on to this relationship no

I swear I am DONE. That line sealed it for me. To every girl on this

honestly, what’s even left?!), and just enjoy being *us.*

As I always say — I’ll do this for the rest of my life. And not just say it
— I’ll *show* it.
Your guardian. Of your heart, your mind, your soul.

Your Knight,
With all the love, and the warmest hugs,
*Aashu 💕*

body:
Dear Girlfriend 🌻,

I wanted to write this before I sleep, so that the first thing you see when
you wake up is a little piece of my heart, just for you. Why should your
morning be anything less than beautiful?

I still can’t believe I found *you *— in this massive world full of people.
The hardest part was finding you… now that I have, everything feels
simpler. From here on, it’s just you and me — walking through all the
winters, summers, and springs life brings our way.

And hey, I might walk around pretending I’ve got it all figured out… but
when it comes to you? I'm just a soft, confused boy trying not to smile
like an idiot when your name pops up on my screen. One hug from you could
probably reboot my entire emotional system.

Every time I talk to you, think about you, or hear your voice — I feel
stronger, safer, more driven, and more at peace. You awaken the best parts
of me. And your Polaroid idea? Absolutely brilliant. Don’t worry, I give
you full credit. 🚀

I'm far from perfect, I've got my flaws. Many of them probably haven’t even
unlocked yet. But I hope you discover them (gently please?) and still stick
with me while we patch them together. I’ll do the same for you, no second
thoughts.. Because to me, you're not just a beautiful chapter — you’re the
person I want in *every* chapter from now on. I’ll make sure of that. I
promise.

As you said so perfectly, *“We don’t know what the future holds—but we’ll
get through anything as long as we have each other.”* That one line says it
all.

And about asking you to come over on Monday… I was hesitant. Not because I
didn’t want it, but because I wondered — do I even have the right to ask?
Would you be comfortable? Then I thought: If we’re building something real,
it has to be rooted in honesty, trust and respect. So I asked. And you said
yes — with grace, warmth, and love. I admire you endlessly for that. 😇

MONDAY!! I know — we’re both counting down the seconds. Let’s hang in there
just a little longer, and make it unforgettable when we meet.

*You are the reality I’ve spent so long dreaming about. *My princess. My
Chiki.

Have the most wonderful morning — and a safe journey back home. I’m holding
you in my thoughts, always.

Yours,
Always and Entirely,
The Guardian of Your Heart, Soul, and Mind,
Aashu* ❤️*

subject: Still can’t believe today actually happened 🌻
body:
Dear Princess,

Hemluuuuu…


What a day. Oh my God, where do I even begin?

Let me take it from the top.

(P.S. – This is going to be a long read, so settle in. I hope you enjoy it.)


I woke up at 5:30 AM, excited like a little kid, getting ready to meet my
princess. Even the cold shower felt oddly warm—I had to check twice to make
sure it was actually cold. And then, I called you. You sounded sleepy, a
little low maybe, and I couldn’t help but start bombarding you with
questions: Did you sleep okay? Are you feeling alright? Should we push the
timing a bit?

But you, being you, my cutie, my soft, pretty girl—simply responded with
the calmest, most soothing “Good morning” I’ve ever heard. Bas, wahi pe
pigal gaya main.


You said you’d be starting in 10 minutes, so I got back to getting ready,
heart racing, counting down every second to meet you.


In the metro, I put on some music and kept texting you. And then, this
moment still gives me goosebumps, my favorite version of the Hanuman
Chalisa started playing, and just as the last line ended, the metro doors
opened at Cubbon Park. Perfect timing. Symbolic. Spiritual. I knew
something divine was happening.


Then came the first sight of you, my princess. Honestly, it felt like a
dream. I handed you the flowers and saw your first smile - my heart was
doing cartwheels.


Our time at Cubbon Park truly felt like something out of a dream. The way
you reacted to everything I’d planned made my entire day. From the flowers,
fruits, pepper spray, printed emails, to the Radhe book, every little thing
felt so meaningful because you made it meaningful.


The tiny moments, the two little flowers we tucked into my phone cover, the
photos we took, and those deep, flowing conversations on the mat, meant the
world to me. Honestly, I could write an entire book about today, but for
now, I’ll try to keep it to this email.


Then came the great breakfast hunt, MTR was closed and we were dying of
hunger, but fate had better plans. We found a new gem, and I had one of the
best sambars I’ve ever tasted in Bangalore.


And when I hesitantly said, “I want to go to ISKCON, but let’s see if we
can,” you just replied, “Let’s go in the evening.”

That one line hit me so hard. It made me emotional in a way I can’t
explain. Tum kaise ho sakti ho yaar aese? Really.


One of the highlights for me was us reading our emails aloud at Cubbon. It
was romantic, hilarious, sweet—just unforgettable. I’m keeping that memory
close to my heart forever.


Now… the second half of the day.

Yes, I know, I messed up. I was late, and I made my princess wait. I was
already annoyed with myself, and then I added to it with that stupid
question that I articulated in the worst possible way.

And still, you, being the beautiful soul you are—took it with grace. You
responded calmly, and that made me feel calm. Watching you carry yourself
with such strength, even though you were tired, your back hurting, your
legs aching, dealing with those incoming biodatas (ugh), and then still
patiently handling my idiocy…

I swear, I heard Krishna Ji whisper to me:

“*This is the kind of woman you need in your life. She stands tall in the
face of difficulty, makes comebacks stronger than before, and protects what
she loves fiercely. *

*She is your Radha, sweet, strong, and full of grace.*”

I felt my prayers being answered.

Also, I’m so happy Swastika found her flat. That was a little cherry on top
for the day.

And then, you still went gift hunting for me, even though your legs were
practically giving up. And what you found… Radha-Krishna.

😭 Perfect. Truly. No words.

I also love that our first picture together was at ISKCON. I wanted that so
badly. And that photo—it’s iconic. I’ll always treasure it.

I hope you liked the little sunshine chain from me. The fact that Rajvi
gave you the exact same gift—destiny has a strange and beautiful sense of
humor. I honestly can’t wait to meet Rajvi and bond with her too.

So yes… my princess. My pretty little girl. My Chiku.

How was your experience of our first IRL meet?

I genuinely feel we vibe the best in person than over text or calls. That’s
rare. Very rare. And I feel lucky to have found that with you.

Your guardian knight, signing off for the day… still in disbelief that this
wasn’t all a dream.

Always on high alert for matters of your heart, soul, and mind.

Yours always,

Aashu
